column3: The Hebrew pictures relief as making room in narrowness.
The Hebrew addresses sons of a man and describes his glory becoming shame without a passive verb of maligning.
The Hebrew says speak in your heart; BSB says search your heart.
The Hebrew says sacrifices of righteousness; BSB says sacrifices of the righteous.
The Hebrew says lift the light over us; BSB says shine it upon us.
The Hebrew explicitly calls the grain and new wine theirs.
The Hebrew explicitly joins lying down and sleeping with together.
